free.title: Little Red Lighthouse Festival
free.caption:
FREE · LITTLE RED LIGHTHOUSE FESTIVAL

Manhattan's only lighthouse is throwing a free festival this Saturday under the George Washington Bridge.

The Little Red Lighthouse in Fort Washington Park turns the Hudson waterfront into an afternoon block party: live sets from Moosiki Kids, Leadlights Ensemble and General Mischief Dance Theatre, a staged tribute to the 1942 book that saved this lighthouse from demolition, and rare tours up top.

Lighthouse tours are first-come, first-served starting at noon - show up early if climbing it is the plan.

Send this to whoever still has that book memorized from story time.

📷 NY Landmarks Conservancy / Noel Sutherland

art.title: The Friends Experience
art.caption:
ART · THE FRIENDS EXPERIENCE

The Central Perk couch is real, it's in Flatiron, and you can sit on it.

The Friends Experience rebuilds the show's most famous sets room by room - the orange couch and neon sign at Central Perk, Monica's purple door and kitchen island, even original costumes and props. It's a one-hour, self-guided walk built entirely for photos, and most visitors say it's worth the hype.

Book online before you go - weekday slots move faster, and it's closed Tuesdays.

Tag the friend who still knows everyone's Central Perk order by heart.

📷 The Friends Experience NYC

food.title: Weekend 5 - Oct 3-4
food.caption:
WEEKEND 5 · OCT 3-4

Five ways to fill this weekend, from a free floating concert to an 8th-annual Creole food fest.

Saturday and Sunday across the city: Welcome to Chinatown's Mid-Autumn Festival at Gotham Park, the 18th annual NYC Yarn Crawl through 13 shops, a free Bargemusic concert on a barge in DUMBO, the Creole Food Fest at Brooklyn Bridge Park, and one last Freaky Movie Friday at Foxtail tonight.

Mix free and paid - most of this weekend costs nothing but a subway swipe.

Send this to the group chat before everyone makes separate plans.

📷 NYC Parks / Bargemusic / Creole Food Festival
